note: Classical Sallusto/Lanzavecchia CD8 memory layout on CCR7 × CD45RA. Strategy: (1) Naive_CD8 anchors on the dense blob at the upper-right corner (CCR7 very high, CD45RA high) — antigen-inexperienced naive cytotoxic T cells. (2) EMRA_CD8 sits immediately to the left of Naive_CD8 in the upper CD45RA band — terminally differentiated cytotoxic T cells. (3) In the lower CD45RA band (memory cells), CCR7 is bimodal — locate the CCR7+ peak; CM_CD8 (central memory; lymph-node homing) sits at/right of this peak, EM_CD8 (effector memory) sits to its left. CCR7 (and sometimes CD45RA) can be trimodal in this panel, so density peaks — not fixed thresholds — anchor the gate.
tips: Classical Sallusto/Lanzavecchia CD8 memory scheme (CCR7 × CD45RA). Naive_CD8: CCR7+ CD45RA+. CM_CD8: CCR7+ CD45RA-. EM_CD8: CCR7- CD45RA-. EMRA_CD8: CCR7- CD45RA+. Tissue context: in non-lymphoid tissues (Liver, Lung, Ileum) the Naive_CD8 fraction is expected to be low — substantial Naive_CD8 in those tissues may indicate blood contamination; lymphoid tissues (Spleen, mLN, tLN, BM) retain more Naive_CD8. Useful co-markers: CD45RO / CD27 / CD28 would refine memory staging but are not in panel; CD69 + CD103 (both in panel) identify tissue-resident memory (Trm) and are resolved separately at Step 9 for Th1.
